rationale: AR-0063: component scores 99/100 while its hottest single transaction reaches only 59.

steps.narrative: Ordinary merchant traffic. Every order scores low and is allowed through without friction.
New orders arrive. None of them would trigger an intervention on its own — a row-level model sees nothing worth stopping.
More orders from different accounts. They share 5 devices and 3 delivery addresses, but no single order looks wrong.
The risk graph runs over the trailing window, linking accounts through the entities they share.
17 accounts form one connected group scoring 99 out of 100. Exposure is INR 270,169.

evidence.statement: 17 accounts are connected through 5 devices, 3 delivery addresses and 3 IP addresses.
Refunded share of captured value is 0.74 (6.9x the merchant baseline).
Days between first and last account signup is 13.13 (merchant baseline 144.10).
Share of devices, addresses and codes shared between accounts is 0.91 (1.5x the merchant baseline).
Share of accounts created within 24 hours of the first is 0.06 (merchant baseline 0.33).
Accounts per device is 3.40 (2.0x the merchant baseline).

policy.reason: Risk score 99 falls in the 90-100 band, which always requires human review.
